questions.stem: What is the sum of the first 10 odd numbers?

hint.level_0: Write out the numbers being summed before adding anything.
hint.level_1: Pair them up — first + last, second + second-last. Each pair adds to the same total!

questions.stem: If a + b = 15 and a - b = 5, what is the value of a?

hint.level_0: Two facts: a + b = 15 and a − b = 5. We want one of the letters.
hint.level_1: Add the two equations together — the b's cancel out, leaving only a's.
